metadata.description: Agent-use-ready US equity + biotech investment-intelligence skills and plugins for Claude Code, Claude Cowork, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Codex, and Goose. Backed by agentii.ai's data API (SEC filings, XBRL facts, earnings calendar, clinical trials, FDA approvals) with gold-label signal extraction and a four-verb MCP tool taxonomy.

plugins.name: equity-research-core
plugins.description: 8 equity-research dimension skills with ~48 addressable sub-prompt modes: recent-quarter performance, competitive landscape, growth strategy, secular tech trends, turnaround analysis, risk analysis, earnings sentiment, and valuation methods.

plugins.name: business-intelligence
plugins.description: 5 business-intelligence skills: business-model analysis, revenue decomposition, unit economics, what-if scenarios, and operational KPI tracking.

plugins.name: industry-analysis
plugins.description: 4 industry-analysis skills: peer benchmarking, sector overview, competitive positioning, and supply-chain mapping.

plugins.name: models-and-pitches
plugins.description: 7 financial-modeling + presentation skills: DCF, comps, 3-statement, LBO, audit-xls, xlsx-author, and pitch-deck. 6 ported from anthropics/financial-services (Apache-2.0); pitch-deck is net-new. All Excel-producing skills follow the FR-044 4-step office protocol (spec → build → recalc → audit).

plugins.name: agentii-equity-agent
plugins.description: Orchestrating agent plugin bundling all 24 skills from the 4 vertical plugins, with a long-range equity research system prompt ported from references/prompts/system_v2_7.py.
